MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_SOVEREI: When you take unblocked damage, Exhaust a Sovereign Shield.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_BLEED_P: Whenever you take attack damage, lose an additional {BleedPercent}% of your maximum HP.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_KING_GU:
At the start of your turn, Exhaust a card from your hand. Deal its damage + this power's stacks to a random enemy.
Forge increases this power's stacks and generates Bullets instead of a new weapon.{BulletExtraHit:cond:
Deal damage again when a Bullet is Exhausted.|}{JadeBonus:cond:
Deal 4 additional damage when Exhausting a non-Bullet card.|}
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_HIGH_GR:
Take {DamageDecrease}% less damage and deal {DamageIncrease}% more damage.
Whenever you take unblocked damage, lose 1 stack.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_HEAVY_P:
Damage below the warhammer threshold is reduced to 0.
Records the highest 10 + Forge threshold this combat when applied.
Lose 1 stack at the end of its turn.

Damage below {DamageThreshold}, after modifiers, is reduced to 0.
Lose 1 stack at the end of its turn.
Reapplying adds stacks and keeps the higher threshold.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_STAFF_S:
Cannot act for 2 enemy turns.
Another Heavy Chop restores the duration to at least 2 turns.

Cannot act for the next {Amount} enemy turns.
Another Heavy Chop restores the duration to at least 2 turns.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_MARTIAL:
Royal Knuckles are the only Attack you can play.
Whenever you deal unblocked damage, [gold]Forge[/gold] {ForgeAmount}.
Whenever you fully Block enemy damage, gain 1 [gold]Adaptation[/gold], up to {MaximumStacks} stacks.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_ADAPTAT:
Each stack reduces damage taken by 20% and increases damage dealt by 20%.
Maximum {MaximumStacks} stacks.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_LIFE_LO:
Receive 2 additional stacks of each debuff.
Lasts this combat. Reapplying does not stack.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_REND_PO:
Whenever you attack, lose 10% of your maximum HP and 1 stack.
Multi-hit attacks trigger this only once.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_POWER_TSUNAMI:
Halve current Block and future Block gained.
Lasts this combat. Reapplying does not stack.
